protocol.startingSides: A, B before sideboarding; A, B after sideboarding
protocol.pairing: Same engine seeds and starting deck orders for baseline/candidate pairs; different matches may have different orders
protocol.weighting: Equal weight per opponent deck, then equal weight per version within a deck
protocol.acceptance: Promote only for strictly higher weighted win rate on saved paired matches; retain on ties, regressions or incomplete comparisons
protocol.selfPlay: Always include the frozen starting target AI among opponents

execution.review: Pause at authorized stage boundaries in step-by-step mode
execution.cancellation: CANCEL marker or SIGINT; allow 60 seconds for shutdown, then terminate only the owned process group
execution.baselineReuse: Require matching schedule, inputs, implementation, settings and verified evidence
execution.gameAccounting: Reserve before execution; failed and interrupted reservations remain consumed; reused results add no new reservations
execution.wallAccounting: Elapsed since persisted campaign start, including review pauses and interruptions
execution.storageAccounting: Retained campaign directory bytes; preserve evidence on exhaustion
execution.deadline: Each operation timeout is capped by remaining campaign wall time
